{"ID": 1286821242824822918, "Timestamp": "2024-09-20 22:48:12", "Contents": "(read this whenever you are anxious or feeling lonely or desolate or sad)\n\nhey,\n\nin case you ever get anxious about anything related to me, or really anything...\n\nyou're not alone. i know sometimes we wish we were. sometimes i wish i was too. but you aren't alone. better yet, you arent abandoned. i havent abandoned you. us not being together right now isnt about leaving you behind for better things. this isnt because you arent loveable or youre a bad person or damaged or whatever else you might be feeling right now. we are doing this because we want to be there for each other. we'd rather take some time off now than live without each other. i'd rather figure myself out now okay? i just need some time.\n\nthis feeling of anxiety and sadness is okay for now. i know i know. youre feeling it in your heart, beating faster and faster the more you think about it. you feel it in your head, all warm and heating up. you feel it in your body's motions, rocking back and forth, tapping, just looking to get out. its okay. im going to see you soon. i cant wait to hear all about the great things that are going on with your life. i can't wait to call you and hear your voice. the same happy note we left things on, the same smile i gave you, the same laugh we had...itll all be there when youre back.\n\nthe only thing we are leaving behind is the pain, okay? the good parts will still be there when youre back.\n\nso anyways... sleep up or keep working or get off your phone or do whatever you are supposed to be doing... okay okay... fine... you get five minutes to lock in. thats it. promise? good :)\n\ni love you navyasara. i always have and i always will. im thinking of you right now, and im giving you a million hugs and kisses as we speak. but i need you to get up from that hole of despair that youre in and try for me okay? im trying for you too :( please?\n\nif you are in a crisis, or something really bad,  then you can call me. ill pick up okay?\n\nyour loving companion\njorge :)", "Attachments": ""},

{"ID": 1232916186178781245, "Timestamp": "2024-04-25 04:48:45", "Contents": "i havent really made the time to properly write this out, but i figured i should make it now :) i know my jokes have become a more serious issue, and i figured i should explain some things. u deserve that much :)\n\ni think im generally a playful person, no? i like to joke around about things, and generally i dont hold back because why should I right? i like saying wild things, and they make u laugh, until they dont :( i know ive said things carelessly and that goes beyond a boundary i shouldnt cross with you: hurting you. i know you let it go, sometimes you bring it up and then apologize when it should be me saying sorry. ive realized that its a way for coping with my insecurities, and ive let it go on for too long. for me, its become a way to be passive aggressive, to a point where I make you really upset and then go back to doing it again. and for all of that, I only say sorry, assure you and then repeat it.\n\nits fucked up, im realizing it now. its something that ive let go too far, to the point where it should have never gone. im sorry. this isnt on you; its about me being insecure in this relationship. its hard for me to change it because ive accepted it as \"just a joke\" instead of seeing it for what it is\n\ni dont like hurting you. i dont make these remarks because i find them funny. i laugh at them because I dont want to become upset and face about what im actually joking about. i want to make that clear, because oftentimes at these jokes im hurting and letting it out under the guise of \"a joke\" and give the impression that i find it really funny.\n\nthis isnt the end all be all of this issue: we can discuss it and talk about it later. i figured i would just try and get this out now. im trying not to use it anymore, and deal with my insecurities a different way.\n\ni love you. im here for you always.", "Attachments": ""},

{"ID": 1227508391828783115, "Timestamp": "2024-04-10 06:40:06", "Contents": "hey navya,\n\nim taking a break from studying and stuff to tell you some of whats been on my mind. i know youve been asking this from me and im sorry i havent been open about it.\n\nim really scared. the call i was dreading finally came. im afraid of hurting you more. im scared that youre not okay and that i cant do anything for you. im afraid that im just getting in your way. im afraid of getting that same call again. im afraid of making myself vulnerable to you because you have a lot going on and i dont want to put more pressure on you.\n\nim also alone too you know? ive been alone forever it feels like, and youve helped in being there for me, but im also on my own.\n\nim telling you this not as a reason to stay, or to help me get better, but to understand that im feeling similarly to you.\n\nwe will be okay, regardless of how much you or i catastrophize things sometimes. im here for you. i love you.\n\ni dont want you to give up on me. i dont want to give up on you.\n\nplease just try to understand this. it hurts a lot. im hurting a lot.", "Attachments": ""},
